Spatial autocorrelation of the model inputs and the distribution of each variable
after preprocessing.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")

import os
import numpy as np

from data_processing import load_and_prepare_data, preprocess_data
from si_plots import plot_spatial_analysis, plot_city_distributions
```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = "../../figs/SI"
os.makedirs(FIGS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]

CITY_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": ("../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson", "../../data/bay_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Los Angeles": ("../../data/h3_la_8.geojson", "../../data/la_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Mexico City": ("../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson", "../../data/cdmx_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Rio de Janeiro": ("../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson", "../../data/rio_flows_h3_8h3.csv"),
}

VARIABLES = {"eci": r"$\mathrm{ECI}^{\mathrm{emp}}$", "informality_rate": "Informality rate"}
```

## Load Data

```{python}
city_data = {}

for city, (mzn_path, flows_path) in CITY_PATHS.items():
    aligned, mzn, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, home_m, inf_m, _ = load_and_prepare_data(
        mzn_path, flows_path, city
    )
    prep = preprocess_data(home_m, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, inf_m)
    city_data[city] = {"aligned": aligned, "mzn": mzn, "prep": prep}
```

## Spatial Autocorrelation

```{python}
for variable, display_name in VARIABLES.items():
    for city in CITY_ORDER:
        fig, _ = plot_spatial_analysis(
            city_data[city]["mzn"].copy(), variable, city, display_name
        )
        slug = city.lower().replace(" ", "_")
        fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/spatial_analysis_{slug}_{variable}.pdf",
                    dpi=300, facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Variable Distributions

```{python}
for city in CITY_ORDER:
    fig = plot_city_distributions(
        city, city_data[city]["prep"], city_data[city]["aligned"], city_data[city]["mzn"]
    )
    slug = {"Bay Area": "bay_area", "Los Angeles": "los_angeles",
            "Mexico City": "cdmx", "Rio de Janeiro": "rio"}[city]
    fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/{slug}_distributions.pdf",
                dpi=300, facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Collinearity between the Two Covariates

```{python}
from si_plots import plot_eci_informality_scatter

zone_frames = {city: city_data[city]["mzn"] for city in CITY_ORDER}

fig = plot_eci_informality_scatter(zone_frames, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/s8_eci_informality_scatter.pdf",
            dpi=300, facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```
